tagline: Walk-over and drive-over lines of light, straight or curved.
description: Inground Radius is an in-ground linear luminaire for drawing continuous lines of light into paving, plazas and along façades. Straight and curved pieces, from a tight 272mm radius to a gentle 6.1m sweep, let a single line follow paths and planting edges. The marine-grade stainless steel body is drive-over rated to 5,000kg.
specification: In-ground linear luminaire. Marine-grade 316L stainless steel housing. Opal encapsulated cover. IP67. IK10. Drive-over up to 5000kg. CRI>90. 3-step MacAdam. L90B10 60000h. 24V DC (FL56, 56 LEDs/m: 2.4 | 4.8 | 9.6W/m) | 48V DC (FL112, 112 LEDs/m: 4.8 | 9.6W/m), driver sold separately. Operating temperature -25°C to +50°C. Straight and curved segments: individual, full, start, middle and end pieces for continuous lines.

tagline: Pixel-controlled colour for moving light effects in the ground.
description: Inground Radius Pixel RGBW uses an addressable RGBW strip, so colour and white can move along the line for chases, gradients and animated effects. It keeps the stainless steel, drive-over profile and the straight and curved pieces of the range. White light is mixed across roughly 1800K to 6500K.
specification: In-ground linear luminaire, pixel-addressable RGBW. Marine-grade 316L stainless steel housing. Opal encapsulated cover. IP67. IK10. Drive-over up to 5000kg. tagline: A powerful, efficient flexible LED strip with 112 LEDs per metre.
description: FL112 is a flexible LED strip with 112 LEDs per metre for coves, shelving, joinery and continuous lines of light. It comes with Nichia or Delta LEDs, at 24V or 48V for longer runs, and in a slim 5mm version for tight profiles. A thick copper PCB with constant-current regulation keeps light output even along the run.
specification: Flexible LED strip, 112 LEDs/m. Nichia (3-step MacAdam) or Delta LEDs. CRI>90 | CRI>95 | Nichia Optisolis. 1800K–6500K. 24V DC | 48V DC, driver sold separately. Constant-current regulated copper PCB, reverse voltage protection. Thermally conductive adhesive tape. Width 8mm | 5mm (slim). Cut every 62.5mm (24V) | 125mm (48V). Dimmable. 120° beam. Operating temperature -25°C to +50°C. Supplied on 10m or 50m reels or cut to length. Power, flux and efficacy per metre.

tagline: A dense 5mm flexible LED strip with 175 LEDs per metre.
description: FL175 is a flexible LED strip with 175 LEDs per metre on a board only 5mm wide, giving a dense, even line of light in slim profiles, joinery, shelving and curved details. Choose Nichia LEDs at CRI 90, CRI 95 or Optisolis full spectrum from 1800K to 6500K, or Delta LEDs at CRI 90 from 2200K to 6500K. Cut points every 40mm make it easy to fit short, tightly measured runs.
specification: Flexible LED strip, 175 LEDs/m. Nichia or Delta LEDs, 3-step MacAdam. CRI>90 | CRI>95 | Nichia Optisolis. 1800K–6500K (Nichia) | 2200K–6500K (Delta). 24V DC, driver sold separately. Constant-current regulated copper PCB, reverse voltage protection. Thermally conductive adhesive tape. Width 5mm, height 1.8mm. Cut every 40mm. Dimmable. 120° beam. Power, flux and efficacy per metre. Operating temperature -25°C to +50°C. Supplied on 10m or 50m reels or cut to length.
